milestones.title: M0 — Evidence, synthesis, and contracts
milestones.summary: Make claims, principles, architecture, publication, tooling, and experiment contracts inspectable before treating any development run as evidence.

milestones.title: M1 — Isolated mechanism experiments
milestones.summary: Test one proposed operation at a time against its strongest ordinary null under matched interfaces, budgets, hardware, and decision rules.

milestones.title: M2 — Runtime plus adaptation
milestones.summary: Combine sparse event control with attributable adaptation while pricing storage, replay, rollback, maintenance, and lifecycle energy.

milestones.title: M3 — Grounded developmental curriculum
milestones.summary: Test aligned perception, action, outcome, and language against passive, text-centric, leakage, memorisation, and simulator-shortcut controls.

milestones.title: M4 — Structural maturation
milestones.summary: Retain compilation, pruning, placement, quantisation, externalisation, or protection only when measured savings survive migration and recovery cost.

milestones.title: M5 — Substrate co-design
milestones.summary: Compare accepted mechanisms across conventional and specialised substrates and require a reproducible end-to-end lifecycle advantage.
